import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    crm_feed = inputs["crm_feed"].copy()
    web_feed = inputs["web_feed"].copy()
    
    # Step 1: Create STG_COMBINED by UNION ALL with source rank
    crm_feed["src_rank"] = 1
    web_feed["src_rank"] = 2
    
    stg_combined = pd.concat(
        [crm_feed, web_feed],
        ignore_index=True
    )
    
    # Step 2: Apply ROW_NUMBER window function with the specified ordering
    # Partition by customer_id, order by src_rank ASC, updated_at DESC, email ASC
    # Keep only rn = 1 (the first row in each partition)
    
    stg_combined = stg_combined.sort_values(
        by=["customer_id", "src_rank", "updated_at", "email"],
        ascending=[True, True, False, True],
        na_position="last"
    )
    
    # Group by customer_id and take the first row (rn = 1)
    golden = stg_combined.groupby("customer_id", as_index=False).first()
    
    # Select only the required output columns (drop src_rank)
    golden = golden[["customer_id", "email", "updated_at"]]
    
    return {"golden": golden}
